CardMaker recreation of the '''original''' 0 side (The Hidden Path) of [[The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train]] (Virtual Set 26, 8 December 2025).

Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. No copy of the first Virtual Set 26 release sheet or of the first card images was archived; the re-issued sheet of 26 December 2025 and today's PC card images show later texts ([[The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train (Errata)]], [[The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train (Errata 2)]]).

Text source: the Players Committee's card data, Set 26 entry of 6 December 2025 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/d30e95d3 swccg-card-json d30e95d3]), kept by the PC as pre-errata card 40099 in [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/main/LightPreErrata.json LightPreErrata.json]. Text: “The Hidden Path: Deploy Mining Village, Safehouse, Underground Corridor, and Fallen Order. For remainder of game, you may not deploy <> locations or Jedi (except Jedi survivors). Once per turn, may ▼ a Jabiim site or a battleground (except a Kamino, Tatooine, or [Reflections III] location). While this side up, you may not play Nabrun Leids. Your Force drains at Mapuzo sites are -1. Once per turn, may ▼ a holocron. Flip this card if Jedi occupy two non-Mapuzo sites.”

Made: 12 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (swccg.com/cardmaker), from the PC card image of the current printing (frame, art, title, destiny, margin name); no errata mark. Not an official image.
